fields.Name: T109 - Home Favorites Section
fields.Description: Verifies the Home landing page personalized sections render.

InputDefinition.goal: On the Home landing page, verify the personalized sections render: the 'Pinned' items area (Quick Action Pins — may show 'No pinned items yet' / 'Add Pin' when empty) AND the 'My Applications' cards (and/or a 'Recent' items area). Confirm these Home sections display without errors. Note: the Home page uses a 'Pinned' items section, not a separate 'Favorites' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Home landing page is displayed
The Pinned items area and the My Applications cards (and/or Recent items) render (populated or valid empty-states)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
